SELECT f.execution_code AS executionCode, d.id AS documentId, l.id AS lineId, l.stock_id AS stockId, l.demand_line_id AS demandLineId, l.quantity AS issuedQty, COALESCE(r.returned_qty,0) AS returnedQty, CASE WHEN u.must_be_whole_number=1 THEN 0 ELSE u.quantity_precision END AS outputPrecision, COALESCE(r.invalid_count,0) + CASE WHEN e.workorder_id=d.source_workorder_id AND w.material_frozen_at IS NOT NULL AND q.workorder_id=e.workorder_id AND q.material_id=l.material_id AND q.unit_id=l.unit_id AND q.total_required_qty>0 AND l.quantity>0 AND a.document_line_id=l.id AND a.execution_code=f.execution_code AND a.source_type=#{issueSource} AND a.source_id=CAST(d.id AS CHAR) AND a.operation_id=d.post_request_id AND a.action_type=#{issueAction} AND a.quantity_delta=-l.quantity AND a.stock_id=l.stock_id AND a.material_id=l.material_id AND a.warehouse_id=l.warehouse_id AND a.unit_id=l.unit_id
AND ((CAST(a.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(l.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.batch_no)) OR (a.batch_no IS NULL AND l.batch_no IS NULL)) AND ((CAST(a.bin_code AS BINARY(256))=CAST(l.bin_code AS BINARY(256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(a.bin_code)=OCTET_LENGTH(l.bin_code)) OR (a.bin_code IS NULL AND l.bin_code IS NULL)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS invalidCount, q.total_required_qty AS requiredQty, q.planned_qty AS plannedQty, 1 AS allocationCount, COALESCE(r.return_count,0) AS returnCount FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code JOIN wm_stock_document_line l ON l.document_id=d.id JOIN mes_production_execution e ON e.execution_code=f.execution_code JOIN workorder w ON w.id=e.workorder_id LEFT JOIN mes_workorder_material q ON q.id=l.demand_line_id LEFT JOIN material m ON m.id=e.product_id LEFT JOIN unit_measure u ON u.id=m.unit_id LEFT JOIN wm_stock_action a ON a.id=l.stock_action_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT t.reference_action_id, SUM(t.quantity_delta) AS returned_qty, COUNT(*) AS return_count, SUM(CASE WHEN t.quantity_delta>0 AND t.execution_code=o.execution_code AND t.source_type=o.source_type AND t.source_id=o.source_id AND t.stock_id=o.stock_id AND t.material_id=o.material_id AND t.warehouse_id=o.warehouse_id AND t.unit_id=o.unit_id AND ((CAST(t.batch_no AS BINARY(512))=CAST(o.batch_no AS BINARY(512)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(t.batch_no)=OCTET_LENGTH(o.batch_no)) OR (t.batch_no IS NULL AND o.batch_no IS NULL)) AND ((CAST(t.bin_code AS BINARY(256))=CAST(o.bin_code AS BINARY(256)) AND OCTET_LENGTH(t.bin_code)=OCTET_LENGTH(o.bin_code)) OR (t.bin_code IS NULL AND o.bin_code IS NULL)) THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS invalid_count FROM wm_stock_action t JOIN wm_stock_action o ON o.id=t.reference_action_id WHERE t.action_type=#{returnAction} AND o.execution_code IN #{code} GROUP BY t.reference_action_id ) r ON r.reference_action_id=l.stock_action_id WHERE f.input_kind=#{productionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{localOnly} AND d.document_type=#{issueType} AND d.status=#{posted} AND f.execution_code IN #{code} ORDER BY e.id,d.id,l.id LIMIT 10001

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code WHERE f.execution_code=#{executionCode} AND f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted}

SELECT l.demand_line_id, SUM(l.quantity - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(a.quantity_delta) FROM wm_stock_action a WHERE a.reference_action_id=l.stock_action_id AND a.action_type=#{enumReturn}),0)) AS quantity FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.document_id IN (SELECT d.id ) GROUP BY l.demand_line_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wm_stock_document_line l WHERE l.demand_line_id IS NULL AND l.document_id IN (SELECT d.id )

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL)

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.output_qty),0) AS output_qty, COALESCE(SUM(component_totals.material_qty),0) AS material_qty, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN f.output_qty>0 AND component_totals.line_count=1 AND component_totals.material_id=#{materialId} AND component_totals.unit_id=#{unitId} AND component_totals.material_qty>0 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END),0) AS invalid_count FROM mes_material_issue_input f JOIN wm_stock_document d ON d.id=f.document_id AND d.source_execution_code=f.execution_code LEFT JOIN (SELECT document_id,COUNT(*) line_count,MIN(material_id) material_id,MIN(unit_id) unit_id,SUM(quantity) material_qty FROM wm_stock_document_line GROUP BY document_id) component_totals ON component_totals.document_id=d.id WHERE d.source_workorder_id=#{workorderId} AND f.input_kind=#{enumProductionInput} AND f.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL AND f.stock_applied=TRUE AND f.source_mode=#{enumLocalOnly} AND d.document_type=#{enumMaterialIssue} AND d.status=#{enumPosted}
